objective_summary.value: The primary objective of the SAME-R investigation was to quantify liquid smoke particulate sizes in low gravity and relate the droplet size distribution to smoke generation and transport conditions.
objective_summary.quote: Similar to the original SAME investigation, the primary objective of the SAME-R investigation was to quantify the sizes that the liquid smoke particulate achieves in low gravity and to relate the droplet size distribution to the smoke generation and smoke transport conditions in the experiment.

earth_applications.value: Smoke detectors developed from this research can be applied in extreme environments on Earth such as submarines or underwater laboratories to improve fire safety.
earth_applications.quote: The smoke detectors developed from the results of SAME can also be useful in other extreme environments on Earth, such as submarines or underwater laboratories.
